steps.name: environment - install Swift toolchain and persist environment
steps.description: Install an Ubuntu 24.04-compatible Swift toolchain chosen by SWIFT_VERSION and host CPU architecture; verify checksum via release checksum index if available; check disk space; extract under /opt, validate extracted folder, create /opt/swift symlink, persist PATH and LANG/LC_ALL in /etc/profile.d/swift.sh, and validate swift and swift package availability. Create an optional safe entrypoint wrapper at /usr/local/bin/entrypoint-swift.sh that execs provided commands (does not run tests by default). This step fails fast with clear errors if an appropriate artifact is not found for the host arch or if checksum verification fails.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-321125-321134/calculator_frontend"
: "${SWIFT_VERSION:=5.9.4}"
: "${SKIP_OS_CHECK:=0}"
: "${SWIFT_ARCH:=auto}"
# Detect arch
arch=$(uname -m)
case "$arch" in
  x86_64) ARCH_TAG="x86_64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ARCH_TAG="aarch64" ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: unsupported CPU arch: $arch" >&2; exit 10 ;;
esac
# Validate OS
. /etc/os-release || true
if [ "${SKIP_OS_CHECK}" != "1" ]; then
  if [ "${ID:-}" != "ubuntu" ]; then echo "ERROR: expected Ubuntu host (found ${ID:-unknown})" >&2; exit 11; fi
  major=${VERSION_ID%%.*}
  if [ "$major" != "24" ]; then echo "ERROR: expected Ubuntu 24.x (found ${VERSION_ID:-unknown})" >&2; exit 12; fi
fi
# construct candidate filenames
BASE_URL="https://download.swift.org/releases"
PKG_BASE="swift-${SWIFT_VERSION}-RELEASE"
TARBALLS=("${PKG_BASE}-ubuntu24.04-${ARCH_TAG}.tar.gz" "${PKG_BASE}-ubuntu24.04.tar.gz" "${PKG_BASE}.tar.gz")
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT
# check disk space (need ~200MB free at min, recommend 1G)
avail_kb=$(df --output=avail -k /opt | tail -n1 || echo 0)
if [ "$avail_kb" -lt 200000 ]; then echo "ERROR: low disk space on /opt (need ~200MB free). available=${avail_kb}KB" >&2; exit 13; fi
# find a downloadable tarball and checksum
found_url=""
found_name=""
for t in "${TARBALLS[@]}"; do
  url="$BASE_URL/${PKG_BASE}/${t}"
  if curl -I --fail -sS "$url" >/dev/null 2>&1; then found_url="$url"; found_name="$t"; break; fi
  # fallback to top-level
  url2="https://download.swift.org/${PKG_BASE}/${t}"
  if curl -I --fail -sS "$url2" >/dev/null 2>&1; then found_url="$url2"; found_name="$t"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$found_url" ]; then echo "ERROR: No suitable Swift tarball found for version $SWIFT_VERSION arch $ARCH_TAG; try different SWIFT_VERSION" >&2; exit 14; fi
# attempt to fetch checksum index for the release
curl -sS --fail "$BASE_URL/${PKG_BASE}/checksums.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/checksums.txt" 2>/dev/null || curl -sS --fail "$BASE_URL/${PKG_BASE}/sha256s.txt" -o "$TMPDIR/checksums.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
# download tarball
curl --fail --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -sS "$found_url" -o "$TMPDIR/swift.tar.gz"
# determine checksum
if [ -s "$TMPDIR/checksums.txt" ]; then
  sha=$(awk -v f="$found_name" '$0 ~ f {print $1; exit}' "$TMPDIR/checksums.txt" || true)
  if [ -z "$sha" ]; then sha=$(awk '{print $1; exit}' "$TMPDIR/checksums.txt" || true); fi
else
  # fallback: try .sha256 beside tarball
  if curl -sS --fail "${found_url}.sha256" -o "$TMPDIR/swift.sha256" 2>/dev/null; then
    sha=$(awk '{print $1}' "$TMPDIR/swift.sha256" | head -n1 || true)
  else
    echo "ERROR: checksum not found for $found_name (no checksums.txt or .sha256)" >&2; exit 15
  fi
fi
if [ -z "$sha" ]; then echo "ERROR: could not determine checksum for $found_name" >&2; exit 16; fi
printf "%s  %s
" "$sha" "$found_name" > "$TMPDIR/swift.check"
( cd "$TMPDIR" && sha256sum -c swift.check ) || { echo 'ERROR: SHA256 verification failed' >&2; exit 17; }
# extract
sudo mkdir -p /opt
sudo tar -C /opt -xzf "$TMPDIR/swift.tar.gz"
# verify extracted top-level folder
extracted=$(tar -tzf "$TMPDIR/swift.tar.gz" | head -n1 | cut -f1 -d"/")
if [ -z "$extracted" ] || [ ! -d "/opt/$extracted" ]; then echo "ERROR: unexpected extraction layout: $extracted" >&2; exit 18; fi
# create symlink
sudo ln -sfn "/opt/$extracted" /opt/swift
# persist environment via profile.d
PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/swift.sh
sudo bash -c "cat > ${PROFILE_FILE} <<'EOF'
# Swift toolchain
export PATH=/opt/swift/usr/bin:\${PATH:-/usr/bin:/bin}
export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
EOF"
sudo chmod 0755 "$PROFILE_FILE"
# make available immediately to this shell
export PATH=/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH
export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
# validate swift and swift package availability
if ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: swift CLI not found after install' >&2; exit 19; fi
if ! swift --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: swift failed to execute' >&2; exit 20; fi
# ensure swift package manager availability
if ! swift package --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: swift package (SwiftPM) not available with this swift build' >&2; exit 21; fi
# create safe entrypoint that execs arguments (does not run tests by default)
ENTRY=/usr/local/bin/entrypoint-swift.sh
sudo bash -c "cat > ${ENTRY} <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
exec \"\$@\"
EOF"
sudo chmod 0755 "$ENTRY"
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies - ensure native packages for Swift runtime and build
steps.description: Non-interactively install native packages commonly required by Swift and SwiftPM on Ubuntu 24.04 (only missing packages are installed). Adds additional packages requested by analyst (zlib1g-dev, libcurl4-openssl-dev, libssl-dev) to the previously included set.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-321125-321134/calculator_frontend"
PKGS=(libicu-dev libxml2-dev libsqlite3-dev zlib1g-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libssl-dev ca-certificates gnupg)
MISSING=()
for p in "${PKGS[@]}"; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING+=("$p"); done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends "${MISSING[@]}" || { echo 'ERROR: apt-get install failed' >&2; exit 2; }; sudo apt-get clean -y >/dev/null || true; fi
exit 0

steps.name: scaffolding - idempotent SwiftPM package, conditional platform stubs and tests
steps.description: Create an idempotent SwiftPM package for Calculator logic under the workspace. If Package.swift exists, back it up and leave in place. Detect iOS-specific imports and only add PlatformStubs target and make Calculator depend on it when stubs are needed. Create Calculator source and XCTest unit tests for arithmetic operations. Add small helper scripts swift-build.sh and swift-test.sh. This keeps UI code isolated and ensures tests compile on Linux.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-321125-321134/calculator_frontend"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
PKG_FILE="$WORKSPACE/Package.swift"
# detect iOS imports
if grep -R --line-number -E "import\s+(UIKit|AppKit|SwiftUI)" --exclude-dir=".build" "$WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null; then
  NEED_STUBS=1
else
  NEED_STUBS=0
fi
# write Package.swift if missing
if [ -f "$PKG_FILE" ]; then [ -f "$PKG_FILE.bak" ] || cp -n "$PKG_FILE" "$PKG_FILE.bak" || true; else
  cat > "$PKG_FILE" <<'EOF'
// swift-tools-version:5.9
import PackageDescription
let package = Package(
  name: "CalculatorPackage",
  products: [ .library(name: "Calculator", targets: ["Calculator"]) ],
  targets: [
    .target(name: "Calculator", dependencies: [
EOF
  if [ "$NEED_STUBS" -eq 1 ]; then cat >> "$PKG_FILE" <<'EOF'
      "PlatformStubs",
EOF
  fi
  cat >> "$PKG_FILE" <<'EOF'
    ]),
EOF
  if [ "$NEED_STUBS" -eq 1 ]; then cat >> "$PKG_FILE" <<'EOF'
    .target(name: "PlatformStubs", dependencies: []),
EOF
  fi
  cat >> "$PKG_FILE" <<'EOF'
    .testTarget(name: "CalculatorTests", dependencies: ["Calculator"]),
  ]
)
EOF
fi
# Sources
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Calculator"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Calculator/Calculator.swift" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Calculator/Calculator.swift" <<'EOF'
public struct Calculator {
  public init() {}
  public func add(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int { a + b }
  public func subtract(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int { a - b }
  public func multiply(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int { a * b }
  public func divide(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int? { b == 0 ? nil : (a / b) }
}
EOF
fi
# Conditional PlatformStubs
if [ "$NEED_STUBS" -eq 1 ]; then
  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/Sources/PlatformStubs"
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/Sources/PlatformStubs/PlatformStubs.swift" <<'EOF'
#if os(Linux)
public enum PlatformView { case stub }
#else
import Foundation
public enum PlatformView { case native }
#endif
EOF
fi
# Tests
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/Tests/CalculatorTests"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/Tests/CalculatorTests/CalculatorTests.swift" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/Tests/CalculatorTests/CalculatorTests.swift" <<'EOF'
import XCTest
@testable import Calculator
final class CalculatorTests: XCTestCase {
  func testAdd() throws { XCTAssertEqual(Calculator().add(2,3), 5) }
  func testSubtract() throws { XCTAssertEqual(Calculator().subtract(5,3), 2) }
  func testMultiply() throws { XCTAssertEqual(Calculator().multiply(4,3), 12) }
  func testDivide() throws { XCTAssertEqual(Calculator().divide(10,2), Optional(5)) }
  func testDivideByZero() throws { XCTAssertNil(Calculator().divide(1,0)) }
}
EOF
fi
# helper scripts
cat > "$WORKSPACE/swift-build.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
if [ "${SWIFT_DISABLE_SANDBOX:-0}" = "1" ]; then swift build --disable-sandbox; else swift build; fi
EOF
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/swift-build.sh"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/swift-test.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
if [ "${SWIFT_DISABLE_SANDBOX:-0}" = "1" ]; then swift test --disable-sandbox; else swift test; fi
EOF
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/swift-test.sh"
# record notice if stubs were detected
if [ "$NEED_STUBS" -eq 1 ]; then echo "iOS-specific imports detected: PlatformStubs added to Package.swift; keep UI code isolated" > "$WORKSPACE/PLATFORM_STUBS_NOTICE.txt"; fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-app-321125-321134/calculator_frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Stop PID file created by start
PIDFILES=( $WORKSPACE/.init_*.pid )
if [ ${#PIDFILES[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No PID file found; nothing to stop"
  exit 0
fi
stopped=0
for f in "${PIDFILES[@]}"; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  pid=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -f "$f" || true
    echo "Stopped pid $pid"
    stopped=1
  else
    rm -f "$f" || true
  fi
done
if [ "$stopped" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No running process stopped"
fi
